jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Repair Laboratory & Quality Control Assistant Manager .

This role is essential to ensuring the smooth handling and quality assurance of pre-sale items across our retail and repair operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage the receipt and dispatch of pre-sale items between warehouse and retail locations

• Assess repairability and quality of pre-sale items to determine next steps

• Coordinate with external repair partners regarding item status and service timelines

• Maintain and optimize spare parts inventory to support repair workflows

• Lead and improve quality control (QC) processes within the lab environment.

• Monitor parts inventory to prevent shortages and ensure operational continuity

• Act as a key liaison with retail stores to ensure transparency and efficiency in item handling

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Experience in repair operations, quality control, or logistics management

Strong organizational and communication skills

Ability to manage multiple workflows and prioritize urgent tasks

Familiarity with inventory systems and repair tracking tools

Fluency in Japanese and English preferred

#LI-KS1

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

jobs.title: Stock Associate, Las Vegas Bellagio
jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To be responsible of managing the proper rotation of goods according to company regulations. To support the Stock Manager in all the responsibilities regarding the warehouse and the Store. Moreover, to deal with sales and therefore support the Sales Staff in order to maximize sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure to properly manage the daily goods receipt, to arrange the merchandise following the Corporate procedures, checking and preparing the product to be taken on the sales floor and/or special areas.

• Ensure the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process.

• Assure the right product flow tracking through SAP system.

• Always maintain order in the warehouse, according to the Corporate standards.

• Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines.

• Provide the orders of packaging material according to the store needs.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Previous working experience in similar role

Experience ideally in the Retail luxury sector

High affinity for luxury products

High sense of responsibility

Being able to work in team as well as alone

English is a must other languages are a plus

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

Being a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, embracing the Brand values and convey to the Store Team and Clients to achieve a successful Products performance, driving actions to achieve sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities.

Guarantee an excellence Client Experience through a successful Client Journey.

Manage and motivate the team to drive business: create a positive and harmonious work environment, foster cooperation within the team and between managers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leading the Business

• Drive your Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances and contribution to support the success of the store;

• Support the Store Manager to develop and implement business plans, through the analysis of the product’s performances and proposal of relevant actiıon plans;

• Foster cross selling and up selling among product categories;

• Ensure business opportunities are maximized through efficient sales floor management, being a visible presence and support and ensuring Prada standards are achieved;

• Act as a role model demonstrating sales leadership to the team, support them with their own sales, building and developing your own Client relations;

• Foster the Digital Mindset among the team, as well as encourage and support the team to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business objectives;

• Be constantly up-to-date on market trends;

Client Journey

• Ensure all our Clients to feel welcomed and to take part in an inspiring and engaging Journey;

• Trigger our Clients’ curiosity and to lead them through the values and vision of Prada:–the unique “Prada-ness” attitude, –the intelligence of design, –the relevance of cultural values, –the challenging of conventions, –the commitment to represent the creativity and innovation;

• Feel our clients unique and to express their individuality, confidence and independence of spirit;

• To be passionate through your dedication to our job, Group Values and DNA;

Customer Relations Management

• Cultivate customer relationships to create loyal advocates for the Brand and leverage your team to achieve the highest quality of customer profile capture with every transaction.

•

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow department sales

• Strengthen Client loyalty supporting the department team to carry out clientelling initiatives

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome

Team Management

• Act as a role model demonstrating sales leadership to the team, support them with their own sales, building and developing your own Client portfolio at the same time.

• Support your team with consistent coaching, identify their development and training needs, partner with the HR and L&D team to tailor individual development plans.

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics

• Identify talents within your team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Store Manager in order to define the correct development processes

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;

• Actively support the Store Manager in mapping the market for any researches they may have

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure

Store Care

• Support synergy and cooperation between front and back of house

• Support enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office

• Contribute to an effectıve and effıcıent care of Company’s assets

• Provide feedback and suggestions concerning department needs firstly to the the Store Manager, and if necessary with the Visual Merchandising and the Merchandising departments

• Be the guarantor for an effectıve and effıcıent back of house organization for the department, taking responsibility for the protectıon of the company’s assets as well as ensuring the staff grooming standard is maintained;

• Ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to the Store.

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates

• Having understood the needs and priorities, train and inspire the sales team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Strong business acumen and analytical skills

Comprehensive knowledge of the Luxury Fashion Industry and its trends

Proven ability to drive positive client experiences and build loyalty

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Ability to inspire and influence a team

Leadership and coaching skills

Business awareness

Dependability

Flexibility in schedule and working hours

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

jobs.title: PRADA Runner, Sankt Moritz
jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

The Runner will help in receiving, storing and issuing sales floor merchandise on a timely manner, being the point of contact between the shop floor and the store warehouse.

The store’s warehouse is internal, and the role will involve frequent movement, lifting and carrying of merchandise.

RESPONSABILITIES:

• Product Handling: Efficiently load and unload merchandise to and from designated areas, maintaining the integrity of the products.

• Replenish the shop floor, while helping the sales staff in ensuring the best customer service.

• Maintain and replenish the packaging counter to ensure a continuous supply for customer needs.

• Arrange and organize items on display (both on the shop floor and in the store warehouse)

• Ensure the overall cleanliness and organization of the shop floor and warehouse, adhering to

• Ensure Prada’s standards.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Previous experience as Runner, Stock Keeper, Warehouse Assistant or Retail Assistant, preferably within fashion, luxury or retail environments.

Preferred experience in luxury boutiques, premium department stores or fashion brands, with knowledge of high visual and customer experience standards.

Strong organizational skills, accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Team-oriented and service-driven, with the ability to support sales teams in efficient product management.

RAL: 50.000 – 60.000 CHF

- Garantire gli standard di Prada.

- Esperienza preferita in boutique di lusso, grandi magazzini premium o marchi di moda, con conoscenza di alta

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Prada-Gruppe

Die im Jahr 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada Group basiert auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation. Die Gruppe, ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Luxusprodukten, ist mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church,s, Car Shoe und Luna Rossa in mehr als 45 Ländern tätig und beschäftigt über 100 Mitarbeiter.

Aufgabenbereich

Der Runner wird dabei helfen, Waren im Verkaufsraum rechtzeitig zu empfangen, zu speichern und auszugeben, wobei er der Ansprechpartner zwischen dem Ladenboden und dem Lagerlager ist.

Das Lagerhaus ist intern, und die Rolle wird häufige Bewegung, Heben und Tragen von Waren beinhalten.

Zuständigkeiten

- Produkthandling: Laden und Entladen von Waren effizient zu und aus bestimmten Bereichen, die Erhaltung der Integrität der Produkte. - Ergänzen Sie den Shop-Boden, während die Vertriebsmitarbeiter bei der Gewährleistung der besten Kundenservice. - Pflege und Auffüllen der Verpackungstheke, um eine kontinuierliche Versorgung für die Kundenbedürfnisse zu gewährleisten. - Arrangieren und organisieren Sie Artikel auf Display (sowohl im Shop-Boden und im Lagerlager) - Gewährleistung der gesamten Sauberkeit und Organisation des Ladenbodens und Lager, Einhaltung - Gewährleistung Prada,s Standards.

Wissen und Fähigkeiten

- Frühere Erfahrung als Runner, Stock Keeper, Warehouse Assistant oder Retail Assistant, vorzugsweise in Mode-, Luxus- oder Einzelhandelsumgebungen. - Bevorzugte Erfahrung in Luxusboutiquen, Premium-Warenhäusern oder Modemarken, mit Kenntnissen hoher visueller und kundenbezogener Erfahrung. - Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail, mit der Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten. - Teamorientierte und serviceorientierte, mit der Fähigkeit, Vertriebsteams in einem effizienten Produktmanagement zu unterstützen.

Ausgleich

RAL: 50.000 – 60.000 CHF

Was wir anbieten

Die Teilnahme an unserem Unternehmen bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und dem Streben nach Exzellenz motiviert sind.Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und der Wert, den wir auf das Talent und die Leidenschaft unserer Menschen legen, die zu ihrem eigenen professionellen Wachstum führen.

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Die Prada Group fördert ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld, das allen Kandidaten Chancengleichheit garantiert, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist und wir uns verpflichtet fühlen, einen fairen und respektvollen Arbeitsplatz für alle zu schaffen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
A propos du groupe Prada

Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'est bâti sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le groupe, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church,s, Car Shoe et Luna Rossa, et compte des employés de plus de 100 nationalités.

Objectif de l'emploi

Le Runner aidera à recevoir, stocker et émettre les marchandises de plancher de vente en temps opportun, étant le point de contact entre l'atelier et l'entrepôt.

Le magasin, l'entrepôt est interne, et le rôle consistera à déplacer, soulever et transporter fréquemment des marchandises.

Responsabilités

- Manipulation des produits : Charger et décharger efficacement les marchandises vers et depuis les zones désignées, en maintenant l'intégrité des produits. - Repléter le plancher de l'atelier, tout en aidant le personnel commercial à assurer le meilleur service à la clientèle. - Entretenir et réapprovisionner le comptoir d'emballage pour assurer une approvisionnement continu pour les besoins du client. - Organiser et organiser les articles exposés (tant au plancher de l'atelier que dans l'entrepôt de magasin) - Assurer la propreté et l'organisation générales du plancher et de l'entrepôt de l'atelier, en respectant les normes de Prada.

Connaissances et compétences

- Expérience antérieure comme Runner, Stock Keeper, Warehouse Assistant ou Retail Assistant, de préférence dans des environnements mode, luxe ou de détail. - Expérience préférée dans le luxe de la boutique, des grands magasins ou des marques de mode, avec une connaissance des normes d'expérience visuelle et client élevée. - Fortes compétences organisationnelles, précision et attention aux détails, avec la capacité de travailler dans un environnement à rythme rapide. - Équipe-orientée et axée sur le service, avec la capacité de soutenir les équipes de vente dans une gestion efficace des produits.

Rémunération

RAL: 50.000 – 60.000 CHF

Ce que nous offrons

Pour rejoindre notre entreprise, il faut travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel.

Diversité et inclusion

Le groupe Prada favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant l'égalité des chances pour tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles.

jobs.title: Stock Specialist
jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. The acquisition of Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 has marked the Group’s entry into the food sector, applying the same high quality criteria. Very proactive also in the art field, the Prada Group strengthens its presence through contemporary art projects in constant evolution.

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.

JOB PURPOSE

To be responsible of stock management in terms of KPIs, Corporate guidelines and procedures. To facilitate the selling process through an impeccable stock maintenance and to be responsible of minimizing the stock losses. To ensure the implementation of guidelines received from the Store Operations Department and Store Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process.

• Ensure to properly manage the daily goods receipt, to arrange the merchandise following the Corporate procedures and prepare the product to be taken on the sales floor and special areas.

• Organize, manage and perform the products’ counting and the stocktakes.

• Assure the right product flow tracking through SAP system.

• Manage the product flow during Repairs.

• Manage the stockroom activities related to Markdown.

• Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

• High affinity for luxury products

• High sense of responsibility

• Being able to work in team as well as alone

• Organized and detail oriented

• Mature and assertive

• Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus

• Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

• English is a must other languages are a plus

#LI-LB1

Physical Requirements:
Lifting, pushing, pulling boxes without assistance
Must be able to pack, unpack, and move stock when supporting back of house functions
Must be able to work shift standing or walking

L’acquisizione di Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 ha segnato l’ingresso del Gruppo nel settore alimentare, applicando gli stessi criteri di alta qualità. Per facilitare il processo di vendita attraverso una manutenzione impeccabile delle scorte e per essere responsabile di ridurre al minimo le perdite di magazzino. • Assicurarsi di gestire correttamente la ricevuta della merce quotidiana, organizzare la merce seguendo le procedure aziendali e preparare il prodotto da prendere sul piano di vendita e aree speciali.

• Organizzare, gestire ed eseguire il conteggio dei prodotti e le scorte.

• Assicurare il corretto monitoraggio del flusso del prodotto attraverso il sistema SAP.

• Gestire il flusso del prodotto durante le riparazioni.

• Gestire le attività di magazzino relative a Markdown.

• Garantire i rendimenti, i trasferimenti da negozio a negozio e la consegna di e-commerce seguendo le linee guida e le scadenze aziendali.

CONOSCENZA E SKILLS

• Alta affinità per i prodotti di lusso

• Alto senso di responsabilità

• Essere in grado di lavorare in team e solo

• Organizzata e orientata al dettaglio

• Matura e assertiva

• Business/Retail Management Grado o equivalente è un plus

• Interessi di lusso/fashion, arte e design

• Inglese è un must altre lingue sono un plus

Deve essere in grado di lavorare in piedi o a piedi
